scope: Fixed-noise real Spatial action-head forward, four-step Euler action prediction, finite-gradient check and one AdamW update; CPU and MUSA full-backbone feature pair.
notes: The probe reproduces the source forward and get_action arithmetic with explicit noise/timestep inputs so CPU/MUSA use identical random values.
The source DiT implementation currently ignores encoder_attention_mask; this run preserves that source behavior and does not claim padding-mask correctness.
The strict backbone feature gate remains unchanged and is recorded as failed in the result JSON; functional_pass is a separate finite/update contract.
